svg.aria-label: Terminal. Q: does your AI guess when it isn't sure? A: no. RescueLens refused to guess on 58 of 60 cars it had never seen. Q: is it any good? A: 94.55% top-1 across 196 car classes. Q: and the LLM agent? A: Query2Diagnose: 0% unsafe answers on 300 cases. LLM baselines: 43-70%. Q: does any of it have tests? A: 790 across four projects: ULTRON 337, Neralu 287, RescueLens 94, Voyance 72. Q: hackathons? A: 10 so far. 2 finales: Hack4SDG 2026, and Top 30 in Vietnam. Q: what's his best project? A: not certain. refusing to guess. scroll down and judge for yourself.
